description: This file contains portable C++ templates and classes for safe integer arithmetic operations, including checked addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and other numeric utilities, used within the angle namespace for robust numeric computations.

classes.name: CheckedNumericState
classes.description: Template class managing numeric value and validity state for integer and floating point types.

methods.name: CheckedAdd
methods.description: Performs checked addition with overflow detection, setting validity accordingly.

methods.name: CheckedSub
methods.description: Performs checked subtraction with overflow detection, setting validity accordingly.

methods.name: CheckedMul
methods.description: Performs checked multiplication with overflow detection, setting validity accordingly.

methods.name: CheckedDiv
methods.description: Performs checked division, handling division by zero and overflow cases.

methods.name: CheckedMod
methods.description: Performs checked modulus operation with validity checks.

methods.name: CheckedNeg
methods.description: Checks for overflow in negation, especially for signed min value.

methods.name: CheckedAbs
methods.description: Checks for overflow in absolute value computation.

methods.name: CheckedUnsignedAbs
methods.description: Returns unsigned absolute value, handling signed min case.
